narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Pearl-Handled Dagger, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, you are delivering my dagger? Hah, I suppose my threat rang quite hollow then, hm? I must stay on high alert given my duties here, and especially with oth-- ahem, the foul Syndicate roaming about elsewhere here. Would you be so kind as to part with the blade, now? I must get back to my task.
narrative.requestItemsText: It is unwise to sneak up on me, friend. Speak quickly, and speak quietly.
